item.title: COMMUNITY | Academy scholars visit Wrexham Foodbank ahead of food drive at Ipswich game
item.description: Academy scholars Nikolas Slosarczyk and Daymeon Almeida recently visited the Wrexham Foodbank, ahead of our food drive at Saturday's Ipswich game. Recently, both scholars took a tour of the Foodbank to learn more about its importance to the local community and how the Club are supporting families in need as part of our wider child poverty campaign. item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 5-3 Ipswich Town
item.description: Wrexham AFC returned back into the play-off spots after a thrilling 5-3 victory over Ipswich Town at the STōK Cae Ras. Kieffer Moore opened the scoring before Anis Mehmati drew the visitors level again, a common theme between both sides in North Wales, as further goals from Josh Windass and Iván Azón saw the teams head to the interval level.
